description: GrapesJS provides an open-source visual editor framework and a hosted Studio platform for embedding and automating website, email, and document editing. Its hosted Studio offering includes backend APIs for workspace/project automation and an MCP app for AI assistants.
summary: GrapesJS exposes a REST Platform API at `https://api.grapesjs.com/v1` with bearer authentication and a Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://app.grapesjs.com/api/mcp`.
